blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: decomposition — Break a problem into smaller tasks.
threshold — Value used as a cutoff.
counter — Variable that records how often an event occurs.
boundary test — Input at or next to a permitted limit.
erroneous input — An input violating the program's constraints.

blocks.title: Inputs and output
blocks.text: Inputs are an array and a threshold; the result is the number of qualifying items.

blocks.title: Check each element
blocks.text: The counter increases only for values greater than or equal to the threshold.

blocks.title: Test a boundary
blocks.text: A value equal to the threshold must count. For 5,8,3,8 at threshold 8, result is 2.
